2026-10-09 re-qualification against current published pin reframe4s 292c9bc7 (scalafim main 4756c99c).
Installed the retained factor4 NativeInverseOracleSuite + native_inverse_coordinates tables unchanged (no FnirtCoefficients override; HoldBorderDisplacement not needed). On 292c9bc7 both ANTs and FSL pass Estimated availability, coverage 1, zero divergence, forward/reverse max+p99 <= 0.01 mm, all 962/423 reverse probes and 12 holdouts, but fail the every-coarse-node check: face nodes evaluate to OutsideDomain because the refined continuous index is -1.8e-15 / -8.9e-16 (frame-to-index roundoff) and DomainRestrictedMap/linear interpolator reject a stencil one ulp outside.
Upstream fix: reframe4s branch fix/inverse-face-roundoff 9662317 (on 292c9bc7, local only, not pushed): snap continuous index within 1e-9 of a face onto it before the domain check; unsnapped queries keep the existing path. New regression test fails without the fix. reframe4s-field JVM 52/52, JS 52/52, no warnings.
With -Dscalafim.reframe4s.build=<that worktree>: NativeInverseOracleSuite JVM 2/2 + JS 2/2; evidence identical to retained qualification.json (ANTs reverse max 0.00732356195 mm, estimateNative max 0.0168572582; FSL reverse max 0.00181896117 mm). transformJVM/test 179/179, transformJS/test 149/149. Gates unchanged.
Remaining: publish reframe4s fix (PR to canardlapin/reframe4s), bump reframe4sRevision, land suite + tables in scalafim, rerun JVM/JS + scalafimCompileAll.
